mapper.select: select mn.*, rwi.* from Outline_Project_Risk mn left join risk_warn_index rwi on rwi.rwi_id = mn.Risk_Id where mn.id = #{id}

select * from (select mn.*, opl.Opm_Id, rw.*, ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by rw.Rw_Id order by rw.Rw_Id) as rn from Outline_Project_Risk mn left join Outline_Project_Lib opl on opl.id = mn.Opl_Id left join Outline_Project_Manage opm on opl.Opm_Id = opm.id left join Risk_Warn rw on rw.Rwi_Id = mn.Risk_Id and rw.P_Id = opm.P_Id where rw.Rw_Id is not null and opl.Opm_Id in
#{item} ) t where t.rn = 1
